title: The Greenhouse Pane
description: An aging botanist struggles to let go of a rare, high-maintenance orchid that has choked out every other plant in his care.
character_reference: a lean middle-aged man with silver-streaked hair, square tortoiseshell glasses, wearing a faded khaki garden apron stained with green chlorophyll

scenes.narration: The Peruvian orchid filled the center bench with heavy, velvety blooms that smelled faintly of vanilla and damp earth. Julian had spent ten years keeping it alive against the odds.
scenes.visual: close up of an exotic dark purple orchid bloom covered in fine water droplets inside a warm glass enclosure

scenes.narration: To feed its enormous thirst, every other fern and seedling in the glasshouse had been starved of moisture and light. The benches around it were barren brown skeletons.
scenes.visual: medium shot of dry empty flower pots lined up neatly on a wooden slat shelf inside a misty greenhouse

scenes.narration: He traced a thick, corky aerial root that had wrapped itself around the main support beam like an iron cable. It was choking the structure that supported the roof.
scenes.visual: close up of thick greenish-brown plant roots tightly gripping a damp wooden beam inside a greenhouse

scenes.narration: Julian picked up his pruning shears, their steel blades cold against his palm. He had pruned roses and vines before, but never anything that demanded such devotion.
scenes.visual: close up of polished steel pruning shears held in calloused fingers with condensation beading on the metal

scenes.narration: With a sharp snap, the main stem gave way. A thick amber sap welled up from the cut, smelling intensely sweet as it pooled on the cedar workbench.
scenes.visual: close up of pruning shears snapping through a thick green plant stem with translucent sap beading on the severed edge

scenes.narration: The greenhouse suddenly felt larger, filled with the fresh scent of damp cedar and cool air rushing in through the open roof vents from the garden outside.
scenes.visual: medium shot of a person opening a hinged glass roof vent letting misty outdoor air sweep into a greenhouse

scenes.narration: He placed several small terracotta pots of resilient green moss onto the vacant bench. There was room now for things that knew how to share the soil.
scenes.visual: close up of hands placing small clay pots filled with bright green moss onto a clean wooden greenhouse bench

scenes.narration: True care means knowing when a single grand obsession must make room for a thriving garden. Follow along for more quiet stories of everyday transitions.
scenes.visual: close up of a single glass watering can resting on a wooden board with soft dappled sunlight filtering through mist
